children: Graco closes $447 million acquisition of Valco Melton, expanding precision adhesive dispensing and QA capabilities.
Transaction completed Aug 31, 2026: Graco paid $447 million in cash to acquire Valco Melton.
Net transaction value ~14x 2025 adjusted EBITDA, ~10x 2026 estimated synergy-adjusted EBITDA.
Valco Melton reported ~ $145 million revenue in 2025 and has about 650 employees serving 80+ countries.
Valco Melton will join Graco’s Industrial segment to boost adhesive dispensing, inspection tech and global reach.
